Anna: :wave: quick async standup — tiny, focused one. What I did: ran a full eval sweep on tinyq-2 and KV-shadow; started a promptset smoke pass. Found 2 prompt regressions (QA tone flip, verbosity) and a rerank AUC drop on long-tail queries. Blockers: rerank drop looks environment-sensitive, can't reproduce on staging without the exact beam params. Today: triage regressions, open PR for prompt tweaks, pair with Mike on rerank numbers later.

Mike: saw the AUC drop too. I reproduced locally with seed=42 and longctx traces. Likely related to beam/temperature interplay; trying `beam=5` -> small improvement. Will run a small grid.

Sophie: quick CR ping — PR #824 (model-onboard/tinyq-2) awaiting review. Left a note about default `batch_size` and a nit on logging. Can someone take a look before EOD?

Lee: I can take the CR after 16:00 PT. Also freed an infra slot for a shadow test at 17:00 PT if you want to run the full rerank with KV warmup.

Anna: thanks @Lee — please kick off the shadow at 17:00. I pushed a tiny prompt tweak, sample diff below:

Anna: ```diff
- prompt: "Answer briefly."
+ prompt: "Answer concisely with a short example when helpful."
```

eval-bot: nightly-eval finished: tinyq-2 sweep (run id 1742109999). Results: 47/50 tests passed. 3 regressions flagged: `promptset/qa-flip`, `rerank/longtail-auc-drop`, `tokenizer/spanish-edgecase`. Full report: https://internal-evals/reports/1742109999 (internal).

Mike: linking traces and metrics now: /mnt/eval/traces/1742109999 and dashboard -> rerank/longtail. I see higher variance on >512 token queries. Might be KV warmup timing.

Sophie: acked PR #824 and addressed my comment, left second tiny commit. :shipit: if CI passes.

Lee: booked 30m pairing with @Mike @Anna at 17:00 PT — calendar: https://calendar/redwood/17-00. I'll start the shadow run 5m before to warm caches.

Anna: uploading repro artifacts and a short repro script to the trace dir (`/mnt/eval/repro/1742109999/repro.sh`). Will open ticket and tag the triage board: RDW-2589.

Mike: I'll take the rerank triage and try a micro-ablation (beam/temp/batch). Ping me in thread if you spot any new flakes.

Sophie: FYI I noticed one failure in the Spanish tokenizer test that looks like whitespace normalization — adding a minimal fix to tokenizer util, will run the tokenizer unit tests.

Anna: great. Goal is to have root cause notes and action items before sprint planning. Thanks team — will post triage summary after pairing. :memo:
